captions: 1875: Worrall's Directory lists 'Williams John, Great house', Llandough. Slater's 1868 and 1880, Owen's 1887 and 1891 and the 1901 Cardiff Directory also list him there (CH-0019)
1875: Worrall's Directory, Penarth section, lists a Williams farmer at 'Great house', Llandough parish (CH-0020)
1876–1912: NLW Bute deeds D153/4–8 cover 33 acres 'formerly part of Great House Farm' for the Llandough Limeworks. The deeds are not yet read (CH-0021)
1876–1912: Plan of the 33 acres engrossed on Bute deeds D153/3 (1875) and D153/4 (1876) (CH-0022)
moment.basis: The Llandough poor rate of Oct 1876 (EV-0212) records the entries. The vestry setting and the clerk and estate agent being present are inferred as usual practice.
